definitions.gloss: open ocean; distant waters; the high seas
definitions.explanation: The sea far from land. Almost always used as the first part of a compound.

examples.japanese: {遠洋|えんよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: To go out onto the open ocean.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠洋|えんよう}⟦{漁業|ぎょぎょう}→漁業：20496_gyogyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}っている→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: My father works on a distant-water fishing boat.

examples.japanese: {遠洋|えんよう}⟦{航海|こうかい}→航海：02797_koukai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、⟦{船員|せんいん}→船員：22495_senin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧か{月|げつ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}えない→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: Sailors can't see their families for months until they return from an ocean voyage.
